# telnyx_notification_channels (Data Source)

Lists notification channels, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_notification_channel`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_associated_record_type` (String) Filter by the associated record type One of `account`, `phone_number`.
- `filter_channel_type_id` (String) Filter by the id of a channel type One of `email`, `sms`, `voice`, `webhook`.
- `filter_notification_channel` (String) Filter by the id of a notification channel
- `filter_notification_event_condition_id` (String) Filter by the id of a notification channel
- `filter_notification_profile_id` (String) Filter by the id of a notification profile
- `filter_status` (String) The status of a notification setting One of `delete-pending`, `delete-received`, `delete-submitted`, `deleted`, `enable-pending`, `enable-received`, `enable-submtited`, `enabled`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `notification_channels` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_channels))

<a id="nestedatt--notification_channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notification_channels`

Read-Only:

- `channel_destination` (String) The destination associated with the channel type.
- `channel_type_id` (String) A Channel Type ID
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) A UUID.
- `notification_profile_id` (String) A UUID reference to the associated Notification Profile.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.
